::: {#exr-shift-all}
#### A function with no name

The function `shift-all` takes a list of numbers `L` and a number `d`:

```racket
(define (shift-all L d)
  (map (lambda (x) (+ x d)) L))
```

Guess what each expression returns:

1. `((lambda (x) (* x x)) 7)`
2. `(map (lambda (x) (* 2 x)) (list 1 2 3))`
3. `(shift-all (list 3 1 4) 10)`

:::
